title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 78
paragraphs: The Moschi wore wooden caps on their heads and carried shields and small spears with long points set on them. The Tibareni, Macrones, and Mossynoeci served with equipment like the Moschi's, and they were arrayed together under the following commanders: the Moschi and Tibareni under Ariomardus, son of Darius and Parmys, daughter of Smerdis son of Cyrus; the Macrones and Mossynoeci under Artayctes son of Cherasmis, the governor of Sestos on the Hellespont.
